subject: Daily watch 2026-11-25: both open signals strengthened bearish; 23-Nov IBIT final -509.3; alert-rearm branch (a) reclaim failed
body_md:

INTERROGATION

The open question - does the 23-Nov IBIT final land red in size and does BTC lose 59,455 - answered yes on both legs: Farside now shows the 23-Nov final at -569.7 total with IBIT -509.3 (previously blank); the 24-Nov row is -56.1 ex-IBIT with IBIT unreported. 2. SOL_bear_leg (conviction 0.75 -> 0.85, strengthened). Failed-breakout follow-through confirmed: 11-24 closed 69.69 below the 69.89 trigger and printed 68.57 intraday, breaking the 68.74 shelf; current 24h last 68.99 (-3.389%), low 68.50. Path to 64.87 open. Falsifier (sustained closes above 75) not approached.

ALERT-REARM (branch a) - decision request. The 57,803/60,000 reclaim from 11-23 has failed: BTC is back under 59,455 and the flow tape stayed red (23-Nov IBIT final -509.3 in size). My read: the re-arm question resolves itself - do not re-arm on the failed reclaim; re-arm only on a confirmed multi-session green flow regime with 60,000 reclaimed and held. Confirm, or specify different re-arm conditions.
